nodes.description: Owner address of the Owned contract; set to a fixed address in the constructor and only changeable through the two-step ownership transfer.
Pending new owner address; written by transferOwnership and consumed by acceptOwnership.
Token symbol string, set to XGG in the constructor.
Token name string, set to 10x.gg in the constructor.
Token decimals, set to 18 in the constructor.
Total token supply, set to 1000000000e18 in the constructor and returned by totalSupply.
Mapping of account balances; mutated by transfer and transferFrom.
Nested allowance mapping owner => spender => amount; mutated by approve and approveAndCall and consumed by transferFrom.
Caller-controlled address used for owner checks, balance indexing and allowance indexing.
Pure helper that adds two unsigned integers and requires the result not to wrap.
Pure helper that subtracts two unsigned integers and requires the subtrahend not to exceed the minuend.
Pure helper that multiplies two unsigned integers and checks the result by division.
Pure helper that divides two unsigned integers and requires a non-zero divisor.
onlyOwner function that stages a new owner in newOwner.
Second step of ownership transfer; requires msg.sender to equal newOwner and then promotes newOwner.
Deployment constructor that initialises metadata, total supply and the deployer balance.
View function returning the stored total supply.
View function returning the balance of an arbitrary account.
ERC20 transfer that debits the caller balance and credits the recipient using safeSub/safeAdd.
ERC20 approve that overwrites the caller-spender allowance without any double-spend check.
ERC20 transferFrom that debits the source balance, debits the caller allowance and credits the recipient.
View function returning the remaining allowance for a spender.
Approves a spender and then invokes receiveApproval on that spender contract; state is written before the arbitrary external call.
Payable receive function that immediately reverts, rejecting plain ETH transfers.
onlyOwner rescue function that forwards an arbitrary token contract call to the owner address.
Unsigned addition c = a + b inside safeAdd, guarded by a manual requirement.
Unsigned subtraction c = a - b inside safeSub, guarded by a manual requirement.
Unsigned multiplication c = a * b inside safeMul with a post-check.
Unsigned division c = a / b inside safeDiv with a non-zero divisor requirement.
Balance write balances[msg.sender] = safeSub(balances[msg.sender], tokens) executed before the credit.
Balance write balances[to] = safeAdd(balances[to], tokens) after the debit.
Balance write balances[from] = safeSub(balances[from], tokens) executed before allowance and credit updates.
Allowance write allowed[from][msg.sender] = safeSub(...) reducing the spender allowance.
Balance write balances[to] = safeAdd(balances[to], tokens) completing the transferFrom.
External call to an attacker-supplied spender contract via receiveApproval, enabling reentrant callback execution.
Allowance state write allowed[msg.sender][spender] = tokens committed before the external receiveApproval call.
External call IERC20(tokenAddress).transfer on a caller-supplied token contract, restricted to the owner.
